sentences.sentence: King Uther would proclaim his son as heir to the throne.
Merlin could hear voices of dissent in the crowd.
The nobles would not accept the new heir.
Merlin could not see who was angry.
King Uther might have many rivals.
The baby boy might not be safe without Merlin's protection.
Young Arthur might not know about his fate.
The person who could pull the sword from the stone would be king.
